**Synopsis:**
The RBI has been aggressively intervening in FX markets this week, selling dollars to support the rupee near session opens. Buoyed by $136B+ in inflows from special schemes, the central bank is leaning toward a stronger rupee despite headwinds from rising oil prices (Brent ~$96/bbl, up sharply on U.S.-Iran tensions). Focus now shifts to U.S. NFP (Friday) and CPI (next week) ahead of the Fed's Sept 15-16 meeting, where a hike vs. hold is described as a coin toss — making incoming data pivotal for dollar direction.
